title: Device config - response  (server -> firmware)
description: System.Text.Json serialization (ASP.NET Core Web defaults => camelCase property names, null values KEPT) of api.Models.DeviceConfig, produced by DeviceApiController.BuildDeviceConfigAsync(). Returned by BOTH POST /api/Device/Config AND POST /api/Device/Register. Roadmap #34: Config returns this body when EITHER the device's ConfigVersion differs from the server's OR a command is pending for the device (pendingCommand non-null) - the server returns 200 with an EMPTY body only when neither is true. Firmware parses it in DeviceController::loadConfig(). This file and register.response.schema.json are identical by construction - keep them in sync.

deviceID.description: Lowercase 'd' - the C# property is literally 'deviceID', so camelCase serialization leaves it unchanged. Firmware reads config["deviceID"].

deviceTypeServiceID.description: 0 http, 1 https, 2 mqtt. Drives DeviceController::serviceType() in steady-state operation.

servicePublicKey.description: Pinned CA/self-signed cert for self-hosted deployments; null => firmware validates the TLS chain against its embedded CA bundle.

utcOffsetSeconds.description: Roadmap #39. Current UTC offset in seconds (positive east of UTC) for ServerConfig.ScheduleTimeZone, computed fresh on every response via TimeZoneHelper.GetUtcOffsetSeconds. 0 when no schedule timezone is configured. Firmware adds this to the NTP epoch and feeds the result to gmtime() to get local calendar fields with no on-device timezone database.

firmwareVersion.description: Roadmap #3 (OTA). The newest published firmware version for this device's type; non-null only when firmwareUpdate is true and a deviceFirmware row exists. The firmware compares it against its compiled-in version before downloading.

firmwareUrl.description: Roadmap #3 (OTA). HTTP(S) URL of the .bin to flash; paired with firmwareVersion, same null conditions.

firmwareSha256.description: Roadmap #131. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the .bin at firmwareUrl (DeviceFirmware.Sha256), when the catalog has one - OtaController hashes the download while streaming it to flash and aborts before Update.end() on a mismatch. Null whenever the source has no manifest hash to offer (e.g. a Custom repository without one); the firmware then skips verification rather than failing closed.

emergencyStop.description: Roadmap #230. Tenant-wide fail-closed switch (Tenant.EmergencyStopActive) - true forces every relay off ahead of any rule, independent of deviceConfigController's own relayEnabled.

deviceConfigSensor.description: Populated only when deviceSensorEnabled is true; otherwise serialized as null (System.Text.Json keeps the key).

deviceConfigController.description: Populated only when deviceControllerEnabled is true; otherwise serialized as null.

commandVersion.description: Roadmap #34. Separate counter from configVersion - bumped once per device whenever a new deviceCommand row is created for it. Firmware-side bookkeeping only (compare against what it last processed); the server's decision to send a non-empty response is driven by whether a pending command actually exists, not by this number.

pendingCommand.description: Roadmap #34. Null when there is nothing to do; present only for a real, unexpired Pending command.

sensorBattery.description: Roadmap #12. FK into deviceTypeSensor: 0/null=Disabled(None), 1009=MAX17048 (I2C fuel gauge, recommended), 2001=Analog voltage (VoltageDivider, fallback/necessity).

batteryDividerR1.description: Roadmap #12. VoltageDivider only (sensorBattery=2001): the actual R1 resistor wired, in ohms. V_battery = V_measured * (R1+R2)/R2. Ignored by MAX17048.

batteryDividerR2.description: Roadmap #12. VoltageDivider only (sensorBattery=2001): the actual R2 resistor wired, in ohms.

sensorPH.description: C# property is 'SensorPH'; camelCase leaves the 'PH' suffix uppercase -> 'sensorPH'.

deviceConfigController.description: camelCase serialization of api.Models.DeviceConfigController. Roadmap #21: threshold/hysteresis/interval/schedule all replaced by 'rules', resolved from the device's ASSIGNED ZONE (DeviceApiController.BuildDeviceConfigAsync), not from this device's own row - only relay-pin mapping below is still per-device.

rules.description: Roadmap #21. Every automation rule for the zone this device is assigned to - empty when unassigned. Several rules may target the SAME relayFunction: OR semantics, any rule that evaluates on wins (AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::evaluateRule/initController).

waterPumpMaxRunSeconds.description: Roadmap #21/#36. Hard ceiling (seconds) on continuous WaterPump run time, enforced device-side AFTER any rule decides the pump should run - AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::applyWaterPumpSafetyLimits. Copied from the assigned zone (api.Models.DeviceUnitZone), not this row. 0/null disables it.

waterPumpCooldownSeconds.description: Roadmap #21/#36. Minimum OFF time (seconds) before the next WaterPump attempt is allowed, same enforcement point as waterPumpMaxRunSeconds. Copied from the assigned zone. 0/null disables it.

relays.description: Roadmap #309. One entry per physically-wired relay slot with a function assigned - a slot with no entry is unassigned/disabled. Replaces the old fixed relay1..relay8 keys, removing the hardcoded 8-slot ceiling from the wire format itself (AgrumyFirmware's own MAX_RELAY_SLOTS still caps how many a given firmware build can hold).

skipWaterPumpForRain.description: Roadmap #11. Final AND-NOT veto over WaterPump, computed server-side (DeviceApiController.BuildDeviceConfigAsync) from the assigned zone's SkipWaterPumpWhenRainPredicted AND the install-wide ServerConfig.WeatherRainPredicted - applied by AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::initController AFTER the OR of all WaterPump rules, same architectural slot as waterPumpMaxRunSeconds/waterPumpCooldownSeconds above.

deviceRelaySlot.description: Roadmap #309. camelCase serialization of api.Models.DeviceRelaySlot - one physically-wired relay position and the function assigned to it.

slot.description: 1-based physical relay position on this device's board - AgrumyFirmware indexes ConfigPin.RELAY_PINS[slot-1] to find the actual GPIO/expander pin.

relayFunction.description: 1=Ventilation, 2=Light, 3=Heating, 4=WaterPump (api.Models.RelayFunction) - never 0/Disabled, a disabled slot is simply omitted from the relays array rather than sent with this value.

deviceUnitZoneRule.description: Roadmap #21/#212. camelCase serialization of api.Models.DeviceUnitZoneRule - the SAME class the DB/admin-API CRUD side uses (not split into a firmware-only DTO), so every property below is always present on the wire even though a rule reaching a device is always already resolved to Zone scope and filtered to Relay action (api.Devices.RuleHierarchyResolver) - tenantID/deviceUnitID/actionType/sensorMetric/notificationSubject/notificationBody are consequently fixed/null shapes here, never meaningfully read by firmware.

tenantID.description: Admin-API/DB concern only - firmware has no notion of tenant.

deviceUnitID.description: Set only for a Unit-scope rule - never seen here, since a rule reaching a device is already resolved to a specific Zone (RuleHierarchyResolver).

relayFunction.description: 1=Ventilation, 2=Light, 3=Heating, 4=WaterPump (api.Models.RelayFunction) - which of the device's relay slots this rule targets, resolved device-side against its OWN relays[] mapping above (the rule itself carries no slot number).

actionType.description: 1=Relay, 2=Notification (api.Models.ActionType) - always 1 here, a Notification-action rule is never sent to a device (api.BackgroundWorkers.RuleNotificationEvaluator evaluates those server-side instead).

conditions.description: Roadmap #212. Flat, left-to-right AND/OR list - folds as ((A op B) op C) op D..., never nested/parenthesized. Several RULES for the same relayFunction still OR together on top of this (AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::initController), unchanged from #21.

deviceUnitZoneID.description: Which zone this rule belongs to - redundant with the top-level deviceConfig.deviceUnitZoneID (the device already knows its own zone). Never actually null on a rule that reached a device (a rule only reaches firmware after RuleHierarchyResolver has already pinned it to this specific zone), the type stays nullable here only because it mirrors the same always-present-class as the Unit/Global-scope rows the admin-API CRUD side also serializes with this definition.

ruleCondition.description: Roadmap #212. camelCase serialization of api.Models.RuleCondition - one entry in a deviceUnitZoneRule's conditions array.

conditionType.description: 1=Threshold, 2=Interval, 3=Schedule (api.Models.ConditionType) - selects which of the three conditionConfig shapes below applies. Astronomical(4)/RuleTriggered(5) never reach this wire shape - resolved (Astronomical) or rejected at validation time (RuleTriggered, Notification-action only) server-side first.

conditionConfig.description: Shape depends on conditionType - exactly one of the three definitions below.

operator.description: 1=AND, 2=OR (api.Models.LogicalOperator) - the operator BEFORE this condition in the array; null for index 0, required for every other index.

thresholdConditionConfig.description: Roadmap #21. camelCase serialization of api.Models.ThresholdConditionConfig. Which metric/direction this compares is implicit in the rule's relayFunction (Ventilation=humidity/above, Light=light/below, Heating=temperature/below, WaterPump=waterLevel/below - AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::evaluateRule, unchanged from the pre-#21 thresholdRelayFunction switch), not a field here.

hysteresis.description: Dead-zone margin - must not be negative (enforced server-side, DeviceUnitApiController.RuleConditionConfigError).

intervalConditionConfig.description: Roadmap #21. camelCase serialization of api.Models.IntervalConditionConfig - on for intervalLength seconds out of every interval-second period, grid-aligned to epoch (AgrumyFirmware's computeIntervalState).

scheduleConditionConfig.description: Roadmap #21. camelCase serialization of api.Models.ScheduleConditionConfig - ONE wall-clock window (unlike the pre-#21 deviceScheduleSlot list, multiple windows for the same function are now multiple Schedule-type rules, OR'd together like any other pair of rules for that function).

daysOfWeek.description: 7-bit mask, bit 0 = Sunday .. bit 6 = Saturday (matches C's tm_wday - see AgrumyFirmware's ActuatorController::evaluateRule).

duration.description: Seconds. start+duration must not exceed 86400 (no crossing local midnight in v1) - enforced server-side, DeviceUnitApiController.RuleConditionConfigError.

pendingCommand.description: Roadmap #34. camelCase serialization of api.Models.PendingCommand - the one oldest, unexpired Pending deviceCommand row for this device, if any.

idDeviceCommand.description: Echo this back as CommandId in the Ack call (POST /api/Device/Command/Ack) and in the CommandExecuted event (POST /api/Device/Event).

actionType.description: 1=Reboot, 2=ForceOTA, 3=ForceConfigSync (api.Models.CommandActionType) - same server->firmware raw-int convention as relayFunction/deviceTypeServiceID, not a string.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. A command not acked/executed by this time must not be acted on if somehow still received - matches the server's own lazy-expiry check.
